tools.name: batch_lookup
tools.description: The IP lookup for up to 100 addresses at once, in the order given, with privacy detection. Each valid address counts as one request. Needs the Starter plan or higher: on Free it answers with the plan that includes it.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA) for a domain or hostname, or reverse DNS with a forward check for an IP address.

tools.name: dnssec_check
tools.description: Validates a domain's DNSSEC chain of trust from the root down, zone by zone: secure, insecure (not signed) or bogus (broken), with the reason for any failure.

tools.name: whois
tools.description: The registration record for a domain, IP address or ASN: holder, registrar, dates, status, nameservers and contacts, as the registry publishes them.

tools.name: blacklist_check
tools.description: Whether an IPv4 address, or a domain's mail servers, are on the DroneBL or PSBL blocklists, with the reason and a removal link for each listing.

tools.name: tls_check
tools.description: Checks a website's HTTPS on port 443: the certificate (expiry, issuer, chain, whether browsers trust it), which TLS versions it accepts, whether HTTP redirects to HTTPS, and its security headers (HSTS, CSP and others), with an A+ to F grade and a fix for each problem.

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: One graded report for a domain: HTTPS and security headers, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS), DNSSEC, DNS (nameservers, CAA, IPv6) and registration (expiry, transfer lock), each with a grade, a summary and the problems to fix, plus an overall A+ to F grade. tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Checks a domain's email authentication: SPF (every include followed and the 10-lookup limit counted), DMARC, DKIM keys at common selectors (or the ones given), MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with an A+ to F grade, whether the domain can be spoofed, and a fix for each problem.

tools.name: lookup_asn
tools.description: Owner, country and every announced IP prefix for an autonomous system number.

tools.name: traceroute
tools.description: The route packets take from Dotquad's server to a hostname or public IP address: each router hop with its round-trip time, reverse DNS name, network (ASN and owner) and approximate location. Takes up to a minute. Limited by plan (5 traces an hour on Free, up to 100 on Business), one at a time.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "link_check" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check · Private data: lookup_ip, dns_lookup, whois, link_check, subnet · Public sink: dns_lookup, domain_report, email_check, subnet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check · Private data: lookup_ip, dns_lookup, whois, link_check, subnet · Public sink: dns_lookup, domain_report, email_check, subnet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
